# SimpleTurn

> SimpleTurn sells productized AI ops systems to Canadian residential real estate agents and small teams. Membership includes a downloadable AI Systems Library and a Weekly Drop: one new or upgraded system each week. Prices are in CAD.

## Key facts
- Audience: Canadian residential real estate agents (solo and small teams)
- Founding Membership: $39 CAD/month or $349 CAD/year, kept while subscribed
- Regular price after the founding window: $49 CAD/month or $449 CAD/year
- Founding window closes at 100 founding members or 60 days from go-live, whichever comes first
- Free lead magnet: AI Agent Starter Checklist
- SimpleTurn is not coaching, lead generation, or brokerage/legal advice, and makes no income or listing guarantees
- Support: support@simpleturn.ca
